rootIndependentWholeFilm.finding: The announcement clearly separates Super VL availability from Bolt Oct23 and Alpamayo later-month plans; evidence quotations, byline, publication and Chinese captions form a coherent account. Opening and closing use genuine Huang stage footage with persistent publication-date/recording-unknown labels, not an assertion that the original speaker spoke the narration. The later wide shot shows Startups This Week stage signage. Known scene2 status-label collision and small embedded source thumbnails remain disclosed; no semantic claim depends on reading the tiny source text.

agent.notesPreview: 9/9当前指纹帧已实看：0.17–3.375s 为吉森·黄侧身连续手势，真实运动无卡帧；标题、完整字幕与“资料画面｜NVIDIA发布2026-10-21｜录制日未知”持续在位。水印实测在右上（配置为右下）。原片音轨按公告设定静音。
23/23当前帧已实看：大字英文原句、完整中文译文、署名 Kari Briski｜NVIDIA Blog｜2026-10-21 与字幕均可在390px读完。宿主4项 layout issue 均在此镜：“本地数据与自控部署”蓝色阶段标签重影并压住译文标签；嵌入式原页条在手机宽度不可读。判定为装饰/状态层缺陷，引文语义未
9/9当前帧已实看：Super VL 上架 Hugging Face、ModelScope、OpenRouter 及 build.nvidia.com 的英文原句、完整中文译文（保留 NIM）与署名可读。译文在“ModelScope”处断成“ModelScop/e”，属排版断行瑕疵，不改变引用内容；未改操作者v35。
9/9当前帧已实看：Bolt E4B 4GB 10月23日开放的原句、完整中文译文与署名可读，预告属性由“预计”明确保留。英文在“Oct.”处断成“Oc/t. 23.”，属排版断词瑕疵；与Super VL共用的可用性图仍可读，未改v35。
9/9当前帧已实看：Alpamayo 2 Edge 将于本月晚些时候在 GitHub 与 Hugging Face 开放下载的英文原句、完整中文译文与署名可读，“本月晚些时候”未被写成已发布。嵌入式原页图在390px过小、顶行右侧似被裁，属证据缩略图可读性不足，非引文缺失；未改v35。
9/9当前指纹帧已实看：25–31.46s 吉森·黄由正面转侧身并持续手势，结尾仍有真实运动；后段切宽景，背景可见 starCops This Week 与标识。资料画面标签全程在位；字幕6.41s结束后留白至6.5s，非内容缺失。水印实测右上，原片静音。
整片31.50s（实际31.573s）独立意见：六镜均按当前fingerprint逐页实看。开场0.17–3.375s与结尾25–31.46s均为真实舞台动态，资料标签持续；三张可用性/证据卡的原句、译文、署名与字幕在390px可读。事实边界清楚：Super VL已开放，Bolt 10月23日与Alpamayo本月晚些

independentRootSamples.observed: Real Huang stage movement on opening and closing; publication-date/recording-unknown labels; exact source quotations, Chinese translations, byline and availability distinctions readable in phone frames
independentRootSamples.limitations: Long page thumbnail and source paragraph strips too small to read; large quotation/translation is readable. Stage/status label overprints the translation label in scene2. ModelScope and Oct. wrap midword; watermark rendered upper right although draft says lower right. These remain disclosed visual limitations, not a zero-warning claim.
